name: BMPEA
summary: β-Methylphenethylamine (β-Me-PEA, BMPEA, or 1-amino-2-phenylpropane) is an organic compound of the phenethylamine class, and a positional isomer of the drug amphetamine, with which it shares some properties. In particular, both amphetamine and β-methylphenethylamine are human TAAR1 agonists. In appearance, it is a colorless or yellowish liquid.

pharmacology.text: In particular, both amphetamine and β-methylphenethylamine are human TAAR1 agonists.

uses.en: It has no medical use. It was briefly studied in the 1930s and has mainly been found as an undeclared ingredient in sports and weight loss supplements.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途。它在 1930 年代曾短暫被研究，之後主要是作為運動與減重保健食品中未標示的成分被發現。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途。它在 1930 年代曾短暂被研究，之后主要是作为运动与减重保健食品中未标示的成分被发现。

sideEffects.en: Its effects in people are poorly documented. It raises blood pressure in animals, and regulators have warned that stimulants of this kind in supplements may raise the risk of heart problems and stroke.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的作用紀錄不多。它在動物身上會升高血壓，監管機關也警告，保健食品中這類興奮劑可能提高心臟問題與中風的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的作用纪录不多。它在动物身上会升高血压，监管机关也警告，保健食品中这类兴奋剂可能提高心脏问题与中风的风险。

fact.en: It is a positional isomer of amphetamine: the same atoms, with the methyl group moved one carbon along. It caused a scandal when it was found undeclared in supplements sold as containing an Acacia extract.
fact.zh: 它是安非他命的位置異構物：原子相同，只是甲基移動了一個碳的位置。當它被發現未標示地出現在號稱含金合歡萃取物的保健食品中時，曾引發醜聞。
fact.zhHans: 它是安非他命的位置异构物：原子相同，只是甲基移动了一个碳的位置。当它被发现未标示地出现在号称含金合欢萃取物的保健食品中时，曾引发丑闻。
